'''April 2001 Las Vegas tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Awesome Hobbies, Las Vegas, Nevada on 21 April 2001. [[Brandon Gravo]] won it. It is known from Ben Cavin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2115">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-21-4-21-01-damn-vegas-strumpetsd2115/ 4-21-01-damn-vegas-strumpets], DeckTech (Ben "Jigglypimp" Cavin, 21 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-21-4-21-01-damn-vegas-strumpetsd2115/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Awesome Hobbies, Las Vegas, Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brandon Gravo]]
